name: Pawcision
detailed_description:
Pawcision is a 2D retro-themed Precision Platformer where every jump counts. Take control of a determined cat on a vertical journey filled with danger, frustration, and triumph.

Your goal? Climb as high as possible while timing your jumps perfectly, and try not to fall.

With tight, responsive controls and a focus on skill-based progression, Pawcision challenges players to refine their reflexes and embrace the thrill of pixel-perfect platforming.

Customize your feline adventurer and make your mark on the leaderboards.

Features:

🐾 Character Customization
Personalize your feline with your own choice of color and style.

⏱️ In-Game Speedrun Timer
Track your progress and test your skills with a built-in speedrun timer — perfect for competitive players and time-attack runs.

🏆 In-Game Leaderboard
See how you stack up against other players. Climb the global leaderboard and show the world your precision platforming skills.

🎵 Interactive Music System

Every platform acts like a piano key! Each time you land on or touch a platform, it plays a musical note, turning your movements into a dynamic, ever-changing melody.

🐾 Precision-Based Movement

Walk like a cat and conquer every obstacle with tight, responsive controls. Master three distinct jump types — Horizontal, Vertical, and Wall Jump — each requiring perfect timing and positioning.

  • Horizontal Jump: The distance of your horizontal jump depends on your character's forward velocity. Want to make a short jump? Slow down before you leap. Going for a long jump? Build up speed and time it just right. Mastering your momentum is key to navigating horizontal challenges with precision.

  • Vertical Jump: Unlike the horizontal jump, the vertical jump has a fixed distance. Precision is key — even being off by a single pixel can cause you to miss your mark. Time your vertical jumps carefully and position yourself perfectly to overcome the toughest challenges.

  • Wall Jump: Wall jump is influenced by your character’s forward and vertical velocity. To execute a perfect wall jump, timing is everything — jump too early or too late, and you’ll miss your target.

🚧 Obstacles Overview – What Stands in Your Way

In Pawcision, the climb isn’t just about jumping — it’s about surviving. Every platform and hazard is carefully designed to test your precision, patience, and adaptability. The higher you climb, the harder the obstacles become, requiring faster reflexes and tighter control.

Types of Obstacles You’ll Face:

🔺 Moving Platforms
Platforms that slide, rise, or vanish — forcing you to time your jumps perfectly and stay alert.

⚡ Spikes and Traps
Classic but deadly. Touch them, and you’ll be sent falling back down. Precision is everything.

🌀 Bouncy Pads
Unexpected launches! Use them to your advantage or risk being thrown off your route.

🕒 Timed Platforms
Platforms that only appear or stay solid for a few seconds — demanding speed and planning.

🎯 Pixel-Perfect Gaps
Tight jumps that require exact positioning — one pixel off, and you’ll miss.

🧱 Wall Challenges
Strategic wall placements force you to master the wall jump mechanic and think vertically.

You’re just a cat in a world of impossible jumps — no powers, no shortcuts, just paws and precision.

Like a cat, every jump you make must be PRECISELY calculated. Customize your look and conquer challenging obstacles with pixel-perfect reflexes.
